profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer with approximately 10 years of experience in Technical Support in large enterprise and educational settings.

I'm always ready to learn something new, whether that's a coding language, a framework, something new on guitar or bass, or pretty much anything else!

When I'm not on the clock, I lead worship at Commission Church in Shelbyville, KY, and spend time with my family (two crazy and crazy smart boys and my beautiful wife).
